title: Operations Manager
description:
Operations Manager – Ebenezer Hatcheries Private Limited

Company: Ebenezer Hatcheries Private Limited

Position: Operations Manager

Job Type: Full\-time

Salary: ₹35,000\+ per month, depending on experience and qualifications

Reporting To: Managing Director / Chairman

Location: Kerala

Mandatory languages: English and Hindi

**About Ebenezer Hatcheries Private Limited**

Ebenezer Hatcheries Private Limited is a growing poultry enterprise involved in breeding, hatchery operations, poultry farming, retail/wholesale stores and allied poultry businesses. We are expanding our operations and are looking for an experienced and responsible Operations Manager to oversee day\-to\-day operations and drive operational efficiency across the organization.

**Job Summary**

The Operations Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, monitoring, and improving the company's day\-to\-day operational activities. The role requires strong leadership, reporting, coordination, problem\-solving, and execution capabilities.

The selected candidate will work closely with the Managing Director and Chairman and will be responsible for ensuring that operational targets, SOPs, productivity, quality, and reporting standards are consistently maintained.

**Key Responsibilities**

\- Manage and coordinate day\-to\-day operations of the company.

\- Monitor hatchery, breeding farm, poultry farm, and related operational activities.

\- Ensure smooth coordination between production, hatchery, farms, sales, purchase, accounts, HR, logistics, and administration.

\- Implement and monitor company SOPs and operational procedures.

\- Track key operational KPIs including production, mortality, FCR, hatchability, productivity, wastage, costs, and operational efficiency.

\- Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports to the MD/Chairman.

\- Identify operational issues and coordinate corrective actions.

\- Monitor employee productivity and departmental performance.

\- Coordinate procurement, inventory, logistics, and material requirements with respective departments.

\- Ensure timely execution of management decisions and operational plans.

\- Maintain proper documentation and reporting systems.

\- Conduct regular operational reviews and follow up on pending activities.

\- Support management in expansion projects and implementation of new systems.

\- Identify opportunities for cost reduction, productivity improvement, and process optimization.

\- Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, biosecurity practices, and operational standards.

\- Coordinate with external vendors, service providers, farmers, and business partners when required.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on measurable operational results, including:

\- Timely and accurate reporting

\- Production and operational efficiency

\- Hatchery performance

\- Farm performance

\- Mortality and FCR management

\- Cost control

\- Inventory management

\- Employee productivity

\- SOP compliance

\- Timely completion of assigned tasks

\- Problem\-solving and corrective\-action implementation

**Incentives**

Performance\-based incentives will be provided in addition to the fixed salary.

**Incentives will be linked to:**

\- Timely and accurate daily/weekly/monthly reporting

\- Achievement of operational KPIs

\- Productivity improvements

\- Cost savings

\- Successful implementation of SOPs

\- Overall operational performance

\- Achievement of management targets

**Candidate Requirements**

\- Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Poultry Science, Veterinary Science, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

\- Relevant experience in poultry, hatchery, farming, agriculture, food production, or operations management will be preferred.

\- Strong leadership and team\-management skills.

\- Good knowledge of operational planning and reporting.

\- Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.

\- Ability to work with multiple departments simultaneously.

\- Good communication and coordination skills.

\- Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, reporting tools, and basic ERP/software systems.

\- Willingness to travel to company farms and operational units when required.

\- Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

**What We Offer**

\- Starting salary of ₹35,000\+ per month

\- Performance\-based incentives

\- Career growth opportunities

\- Direct exposure to the Managing Director and Chairman

\- Leadership responsibility in a growing poultry organization

\- Exposure to hatchery, breeding, farming, logistics, and business operations

\- Professional development and learning opportunities

\- Opportunity to contribute to the company's expansion and growth

\- Travel reimbursements

**Benefits:**

Competitive salary \| Performance incentives \| Career growth \| Professional training \& development \| Leadership exposure \| Employee leave benefits \| PF/ESI as applicable \| Stable work environment \| Opportunity to work directly with senior management \| Exposure to multi\-company accounting and financial operations

**Who Should Apply?**

We are looking for a hands\-on, accountable, and result\-oriented operations professional who can take ownership of day\-to\-day operations, maintain strong reporting discipline, coordinate teams effectively, and convert management plans into execution.

Apply now to join Ebenezer Hatcheries Private Limited and grow with a rapidly expanding poultry business.

Pay: From ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment

Language:

* hindi (Required)
* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

London Museum is about to open a bold new chapter at Smithfield. The spaces will be new, audiences will be arriving and an ambitious programme of public events, late\-night takeovers, commercial hires and development events will already be moving. The foundations are in place; now we need someone to bring them to life.

  

We’re looking for an experienced and decisive Event Operations Lead to head up the operational event planning and live delivery across our museum estate. You’ll embed our new events framework, bring teams together and develop a confident operation that can deliver safely, consistently and at scale.

  

You’ll have substantial experience of leading events in a complex, high\-footfall or multi\-space venue. You’ll be a strong people leader who can develop managers, create clear accountability and turn health and safety, fire safety, licensing and regulatory requirements into practical event plans.

  

Previous museum experience and academic qualifications are not required. We’re looking for someone who can see the whole picture, coordinate competing demands and make calm, credible decisions when the pressure is on.

  

For more information about this role, please see the Job Description. To know more about what it’s like to work in London Museum and to get some top tips on how to make the best of your application visit: https://www.londonmuseum.org.uk/about/careers/

  

To apply, . Applications are by application form. The closing date for applications is **Wednesday 30 September**. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview on Thursday 8th October.

  

If you are successfully shortlisted you will invited to an interview where you will asked questions to help us understand more about what you share in your application, and in particular to understand how you meet the essential person specification criteria for the role and demonstrate our museum behaviours.

  

London Museum is committed to being an equitable and inclusive employer, and to becoming representative of the diversity of London. We particularly welcome applications from people from Global Majority backgrounds, who are currently under\-represented in our organisation.

  

We also welcome applications from disabled people, as we’re a Disability Confident Leader and are committed to recruiting, retaining and developing disabled people.

title: Hotel Operations Manager
description:
**Operations Manager – F\&B** 

**Property:** Suburban Residency (3\-Star)  
**Location:** Kanjikuzhi, Kottayam, Kerala  
**Category:** 3\-Star Hotel  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** General Manager / Managing Partners

**Position Summary**

The **Operations Manager – F\&B** will lead the hotel’s day\-to\-day operations, with primary responsibility for restaurants, bar and lounge operations, banquets and food\-production coordination.

The role requires an experienced, hands\-on F\&B professional capable of leading multiple dining outlets, licensed bar operations, large banquet functions and kitchen\-service coordination. The manager will be accountable for F\&B revenue, profitability, beverage controls, food and service quality, statutory compliance, guest satisfaction and team performance.

While the position has a strong F\&B focus, the manager will also coordinate with front office, housekeeping, maintenance, security, purchase, stores, accounts and HR to ensure the hotel operates smoothly as one integrated business.

This is a floor\-based operational leadership position requiring a visible presence during peak restaurant hours, bar operations, weekends and major events.

Key Responsibilities1\. F\&B Operations Leadership

* Take end\-to\-end ownership of the hotel’s restaurants, bar, lounge, room service and banquet F\&B operations.
* Lead the operations of KL05\-1949, Lattice Family Restaurant, Obsidian Executive Lounge and the hotel’s banquet venues.
* Ensure each outlet is properly prepared, staffed and ready before service.
* Conduct daily F\&B briefings covering reservations, expected covers, banquet functions, VIP guests, menu availability and staffing.
* Maintain consistent standards for guest reception, seating, order taking, service sequence, presentation and billing.
* Remain visible across restaurants, bar and banquet areas during peak operating hours.
* Resolve operational issues, service delays and guest complaints promptly.
* Coordinate outlet operations to provide a consistent guest experience throughout the property.

2\. Bar and Lounge Operations

* Take direct responsibility for the hotel’s licensed bar, lounge and alcoholic\-beverage operations.
* Ensure all bar operations comply with applicable licence conditions, approved timings and statutory requirements.
* Maintain strict controls over liquor purchasing, receiving, storage, issuance, transfers, sales and closing stock.
* Verify opening stock, closing stock, consumption, breakage, wastage and variance reports.
* Reconcile physical beverage inventory against POS sales and approved complimentary consumption.
* Investigate bottle\-level, peg\-level and system\-level stock variances immediately.
* Enforce standard pouring measures, approved cocktail recipes and beverage\-presentation standards.
* Prevent unauthorized consumption, free pouring, substitutions, pilferage and unapproved complimentary service.
* Ensure every beverage served is correctly entered and billed through the POS system.
* Monitor beverage cost, pour cost, gross margin, average beverage spend and product mix.
* Develop beverage menus, signature drinks, premium selections and food\-and\-beverage pairings.
* Train bartenders and service teams in product knowledge, upselling and responsible alcohol service.
* Ensure compliance with legal\-age requirements, dry days and other applicable restrictions.
* Maintain high standards of bar hygiene, glassware handling, equipment maintenance and storage security.

3\. Restaurant Operations

* Ensure all restaurants follow approved service standards, standard operating procedures and brand guidelines.
* Monitor table reservations, guest seating, service speed, order accuracy and table turnaround.
* Work closely with the Executive Chef to ensure food quality, consistency and timely delivery.
* Ensure service employees have complete knowledge of menus, ingredients, allergens and preparation styles.
* Conduct pre\-service briefings on menu availability, specials, promotions and beverage recommendations.
* Monitor discounts, voids, cancelled orders, complimentary items and billing exceptions.
* Personally interact with guests and obtain feedback about food, beverages and service.
* Implement corrective action for recurring service or quality concerns.
* Ensure restaurants, service stations, equipment, crockery, cutlery and glassware are clean and properly maintained.

4\. Food\-Production Coordination

* Coordinate closely with the Executive Chef and kitchen leadership without interfering with culinary authority.
* Communicate expected restaurant covers, banquet numbers, room\-service requirements and special guest requests.
* Ensure kitchen production plans are aligned with reservations and business forecasts.
* Monitor food preparation and service timelines to prevent guest delays.
* Participate in menu planning, menu engineering, food\-cost reviews and item\-performance analysis.
* Ensure approved recipes, portion sizes, yields and presentation standards are followed.
* Coordinate the handling of guest allergies, dietary restrictions and special requests.
* Review food returns, wastage, spoilage and guest complaints with the Chef.
* Support the Chef in maintaining kitchen hygiene, food safety and production discipline.
* Facilitate effective communication between kitchen and service teams.

5\. Banquet and Event Operations

* Oversee banquet enquiries, site visits, quotations, proposals, confirmations, advance collections and event execution.
* Coordinate food menus, beverage packages, bar requirements, seating, staffing, décor, audiovisual needs and event timelines.
* Conduct pre\-event briefings with banquet, kitchen, bar, housekeeping, maintenance, security and accounts teams.
* Ensure Courtyard Banquet Hall and Orchid Conference Hall are properly prepared and inspected before every function.
* Monitor final guest counts, food and beverage consumption, additional requirements and billing.
* Ensure beverage and liquor service at functions complies with applicable licence conditions.
* Prevent unauthorized outside liquor or unapproved beverage service on hotel premises.
* Personally supervise major weddings, receptions, corporate events and social functions.
* Conduct post\-event reviews and resolve any pending guest or billing concerns.
* Develop relationships with event planners, corporate clients, institutions and local organizations.
* Improve banquet enquiry conversion, per\-event revenue and profitability.

6\. Revenue and Business Development

* Prepare monthly revenue targets for restaurants, bar, lounge, room service and banquets.
* Monitor daily and monthly sales against budgets and prior performance.
* Track restaurant covers, average\-per\-cover, beverage spend, table turnover and banquet conversion.
* Develop strategies to increase weekday restaurant and bar business.
* Introduce dining events, entertainment concepts, chef\-led experiences and premium beverage programs.
* Drive upselling of premium beverages, signature dishes, food pairings, group dining and celebration packages.
* Study local competition, market trends and guest preferences.
* Build relationships with corporate organizations, event planners, travel partners and local businesses.
* Work with management on promotions that protect the property’s brand positioning and profitability.
* Submit performance reports with clear recommendations and corrective actions.

7\. Cost Control and Inventory Management

* Take responsibility for meeting approved food\-cost and beverage\-cost targets.
* Work with the Chef, Purchase, Stores and Accounts teams to manage inventory and consumption.
* Review purchase requirements, stock levels, reorder points and slow\-moving inventory.
* Ensure all food and beverage items are properly received, verified and entered into the system.
* Maintain particularly strict controls over alcoholic beverages and high\-value inventory.
* Monitor portion sizes, pouring measures, yields, wastage, spoilage, breakage and pilferage.
* Participate in daily beverage checks and scheduled physical stock verification.
* Investigate inventory, billing and cost variances and implement corrective measures.
* Review menu pricing, contribution margins and item\-wise profitability.
* Control casual labour, overtime and other departmental expenses.
* Ensure daily purchase, receiving, transfer and inventory transactions are accurately posted.

8\. Guest Experience

* Maintain a visible and approachable presence in guest\-facing areas.
* Engage with guests and obtain direct feedback on food, beverages, service and events.
* Handle complaints professionally and provide timely service recovery.
* Maintain a record of recurring complaints and ensure permanent corrective action.
* Ensure guest preferences, allergies and special requirements are properly communicated.
* Build relationships with regular guests, corporate clients and event organizers.
* Encourage satisfied guests to provide genuine feedback and online reviews.
* Ensure restaurants and bar areas remain safe, professional and welcoming.

9\. Team Leadership and Development

* Lead restaurant supervisors, captains, bartenders, stewards, banquet employees and other F\&B team members.
* Prepare duty rosters based on reservations, expected covers, bar business and events.
* Ensure effective manpower deployment during peak and non\-peak periods.
* Set clear responsibilities and measurable performance expectations.
* Conduct regular employee training in:
* Restaurant service standards
* Bar and beverage operations
* Liquor\-stock controls
* Cocktail and mocktail preparation
* Responsible alcohol service
* Menu and allergen knowledge
* Upselling and suggestive selling
* POS billing and cash controls
* Guest complaint handling
* Hygiene, grooming and discipline
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, productivity, grooming and workplace conduct.
* Coach supervisors to take ownership of their outlets.
* Coordinate with HR on recruitment, onboarding, appraisals and disciplinary matters.
* Build a culture of integrity, accountability, teamwork and guest\-focused service.

10\. Hotel Operations Coordination

In addition to leading F\&B, the manager will:

* Support the General Manager in coordinating the hotel’s overall daily operations.
* Participate in daily meetings covering room occupancy, events, staffing, maintenance and guest requirements.
* Coordinate with front office regarding resident guests, VIP arrivals, room service and special requests.
* Coordinate with housekeeping on restaurant, banquet and public\-area readiness.
* Follow up with maintenance on issues affecting restaurants, bars, kitchens and banquet venues.
* Coordinate with security regarding bar closing, intoxicated guests, events and guest safety.
* Support emergency response, fire\-safety and incident\-management procedures.
* Act as the senior operational representative when assigned by management.

Daily Non\-Negotiables

* Conduct the daily F\&B operations briefing.
* Review restaurant reservations, bar bookings, banquet functions and VIP requirements.
* Inspect restaurants, bar, kitchens, banquet halls, stores and guest washrooms.
* Confirm menu and beverage availability before service.
* Verify bar opening stock, closing stock, sales, breakage and variances.
* Monitor food quality, beverage quality, service speed and guest feedback.
* Review discounts, voids, complimentary items and billing exceptions.
* Review purchases, stock shortages, consumption and wastage.
* Ensure all daily inventory and purchase transactions are entered and posted.
* Follow up on guest complaints, maintenance issues and compliance gaps until closure.
* Submit an accurate end\-of\-day F\&B and operations report.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured against:

* Total F\&B revenue and profitability
* Restaurant, bar and banquet sales against budget
* Weekday business growth
* Restaurant covers and average\-per\-cover
* Average beverage spend per guest
* Food\-cost and beverage\-cost percentages
* Beverage gross margin and pour cost
* Liquor\-stock accuracy and inventory variance
* Food and beverage wastage, spillage and breakage
* Banquet enquiry conversion rate
* Banquet revenue and profitability
* Guest satisfaction and complaint\-resolution time
* Service speed and order accuracy
* POS billing accuracy
* Staff productivity, attendance and retention
* Hygiene, safety and statutory compliance
* Timeliness and accuracy of operational reports

Qualifications and Experience

* Degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Food and Beverage Management or a related discipline.
* Minimum 8–10 years of progressive experience in hotel F\&B, restaurants, bars or hospitality operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years in an F\&B Manager, Bar Manager, Senior F\&B Manager or Operations Manager position.
* Strong and verifiable experience managing a licensed bar is essential.
* Experience managing multiple restaurants, lounges and banquet operations is required.
* Experience in a 3\-star or higher\-category hotel is preferred.
* Proven success in F\&B revenue growth, beverage control, cost management and team development.
* Working knowledge of POS, inventory\-management systems, hotel PMS and Microsoft Office.
* Sound understanding of food safety, responsible alcohol service and applicable hospitality requirements.

Required Competencies

* Restaurant, bar and banquet management
* Liquor inventory and beverage\-cost control
* Food and beverage revenue management
* Beverage knowledge and bar\-service standards
* Menu engineering and product\-mix analysis
* Banquet planning and event execution
* Food\-production and service coordination
* Team leadership and employee development
* Guest engagement and complaint resolution
* Vendor coordination and negotiation
* POS, billing and cash controls
* Statutory and licence compliance
* Strong commercial and financial awareness
* High integrity and attention to detail
* Ability to make effective decisions under pressure

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be an experienced F\&B professional who:

* Has successfully managed restaurants, a licensed bar and banquet operations.
* Understands liquor control down to the bottle and peg level.
* Can increase F\&B revenue while protecting margins.
* Is confident managing high\-volume dining and large events.
* Remains visible on the floor during peak periods.
* Can build, train and motivate a professional service and bar team.
* Works effectively with the Executive Chef while respecting culinary responsibilities.
* Demonstrates complete integrity in handling inventory, cash and revenue.
* Takes ownership of operational problems and follows them through to resolution.
* Thinks commercially and operates with an owner’s mindset.

Working Conditions

* This is a hands\-on operational leadership position.
* Evening, weekend and holiday availability is required.
* The manager must be present during peak restaurant and bar periods and major banquet functions.
* Duty schedules and weekly off will be based on operational requirements.
* Regular movement across restaurants, bar, kitchens, stores, banquet halls, guest rooms and public areas is required.

Application Requirements

Candidates should submit an updated résumé clearly outlining:

* Restaurants, bars and banquet venues previously managed
* Licensed\-bar management experience
* Approximate monthly F\&B revenue handled
* Food\-cost and beverage\-cost performance
* Size of teams managed
* Current salary
* Expected salary
* Notice period
* Earliest joining date
* Professional references

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person
